purposes.account_data_deleted: The user wiped their account from Settings. Emitted before the analytics reset, otherwise the strongest churn signal in the product lands on a fresh anonymous id and is lost.
purposes.activation_completed: User crossed the activation threshold (the aha).
purposes.activation_milestone: Each meaningful first action toward becoming activated.
purposes.aha_moment_reached: Canonical single aha event: first personalised insight seen.
purposes.analysis_completed: Engine output: insights, anomalies, risks, depth, density.
purposes.app_crash: App crash captured (exception or signal) before exit.
purposes.app_lock_disabled: The user turned App Lock off, with how many days it was on. A spike means the lock feels annoying.
purposes.app_lock_enabled: The user turned App Lock on and confirmed it with Face ID, Touch ID or passcode. The trust signal for sensitive health data, with the chosen relock timing.
purposes.app_store_review_prompted: The App Store review prompt was shown.
purposes.ask_query_submitted: The exact question a user typed in Ask (full text, sensitive).
purposes.billing_grace_started: Entered billing grace — payment problem, at-risk revenue.
purposes.block_tapped: Any actionable card/button tap with stable identity ids.
purposes.breathwork_session_completed: A breathwork session completed, with completion rate.
purposes.core_action_completed: A retention-predicting core action with lifetime totals.
purposes.correlation_tapped: A correlation between two metrics was explored.
purposes.daily_result_shown: The morning-after result of a marked-done action was shown (the loop closer) — the core proof the app worked.
purposes.data_pipeline_quality: Is there enough data to score? Readiness for value.
purposes.data_sync_completed: A data sync finished, with sample counts and timing.
purposes.day1_data_richness_segment: Which branch the day-1 onboarding scan chose: rich, sparse or denied. Guarded once per flow, so a back-nav rescan does not refire it.
purposes.deep_link_opened: App opened from a widget or Live Activity deep link.
purposes.empty_state_shown: An empty state was shown — blocked from value.
purposes.feature_discovered: A feature was discovered for the first time.
purposes.feature_used: Consolidated meaningful product action under one stable name.
purposes.feedback_submitted: Feedback submitted, with category and length (no raw text).
purposes.first_checkin_done: User completed their first morning check-in.
purposes.first_open: Very first app open ever; is_reinstall separates fresh installs from reinstalls.
purposes.first_score_generated: The first real health score the engine produced.
purposes.ghost_session: Opened the app but did nothing.
purposes.habit_ritual_formed: A consistent daily ritual detected (e.g. morning check).
purposes.health_permission_requested: Start of the HealthKit permission funnel.
purposes.health_permission_result: Permission granted vs denied — the biggest single activation blocker.
purposes.inactive_period_detected: A gap of inactivity — early churn signal.
purposes.insight_tapped: An insight card was tapped, with category, severity and metric.
purposes.journal_entry_created: A journal entry was saved, with category.
purposes.live_activity_action_performed: An App Intent button on a Live Activity / Dynamic Island was tapped.
purposes.live_activity_state_changed: A Live Activity / Dynamic Island state changed.
purposes.live_first_data_received: First live data point arrived on the Live tab.
purposes.non_trial_activation: User activated a paid plan without a free trial.
purposes.notification_budget_fallback: Notification budget fell back to a static default.
purposes.notification_converted: A notification led to a real action.
purposes.notification_deferred_quiet_hours: A notification was held back because of quiet hours. (type is a transitional duplicate of notification_type.)
purposes.notification_permission_requested: Notification permission dialog about to show.
purposes.notification_presented: A notification was presented to the user.
purposes.notification_scheduled: A notification was scheduled (id hashed, metric anonymized).
purposes.notification_suppressed: A notification was suppressed by budget/rules.
purposes.onboarding_completed: Setup finished — the gate to every later metric.
purposes.onboarding_drop_off: The screen a user quit on. Fired when the app is backgrounded mid-onboarding. The step funnel only logs screens the user navigates away from, so this captures the exact abandonment screen. In analysis, take the last drop_off with no later onboarding_completed as the true quit point.
purposes.onboarding_goal_selected: User picked their health goals in onboarding.
purposes.onboarding_heart_revealed: The heart rate reveal was shown in onboarding.
purposes.onboarding_notification_skipped: User skipped the notification permission step in onboarding.
purposes.onboarding_profile_set: User set age and sex in onboarding.
purposes.onboarding_step_completed: Per-step onboarding funnel; where people drop, skip or go back.
purposes.onboarding_symptoms_selected: User picked their symptoms in onboarding.
purposes.onboarding_vitality_revealed: The onboarding Vitality Age reveal result: computed age vs real age, younger/older verdict, the colour band, how many real metrics fed it, and whether any health data was available.
purposes.paywall_cta_tapped: Subscribe intent — the click before purchase.
purposes.paywall_dismissed: Left the paywall without buying — where conversion leaks.
purposes.paywall_error: Paywall failed: products, restore, network or decline.
purposes.paywall_viewed: Paywall shown — top of the purchase funnel.
purposes.pmf_survey_completed: The survey terminal event. Without it completion rate cannot be computed at all, because only step 1 used to emit anything.
purposes.pmf_survey_step: Steps 2 to 4 of the Sean Ellis survey (segment, benefit, improvement). Only the step id and how much the user wrote are sent; the free text stays on the phone.
purposes.pre_churn_signal: 1-2 week churn warning from engagement trend.
purposes.premium_feature_attempted: Free user tried a locked feature — desire signal.
purposes.privacy_page_viewed: The privacy page was viewed — concern signal.
purposes.pro_feature_funnel: Which pro feature drives the upgrade intent.
purposes.pro_feature_upgrade_tapped: Upgrade tapped from a locked feature overlay.
purposes.promise_shown: The notification-permission promise screen result in onboarding.
purposes.purchase_completed: Successful purchase with price, currency, trial-conversion flag.
purposes.purchase_failed: Post-CTA purchase failure with controlled reason.
purposes.push_route_unresolved: A remote push carried a route this build cannot map. Deliberately not a notification_suppressed: the push was delivered and opened, so filing it there polluted the suppression-reason breakdown.
purposes.query_feedback: Was an Ask-Your-Data answer helpful? LLM quality.
purposes.rage_tap: Repeated frustrated taps on one element — UX friction signal.
purposes.recommendation_completed: A recommendation was completed — the action loop closes.
purposes.recommendation_skipped: A recommendation was skipped, with reason.
purposes.repermission_conversion: Result of re-asking for notification permission after onboarding.
purposes.return_session: A returning session with recency and cadence.
purposes.risk_tapped: A health risk card was opened.
purposes.satisfaction_survey_answered: Sean Ellis PMF question answered — the PMF metric.
purposes.score_generation_failed: No score could be produced — no value delivered.
purposes.score_reaction: What the user does right after seeing the score.
purposes.score_viewed: When the health score is actually seen.
purposes.screen_exited: Screen close with time spent — time per feature.
purposes.screen_viewed: Screen open with previous-screen and transition for funnels.
purposes.screenshot_taken: A screenshot was taken — share/trust signal.
purposes.scroll_depth: How far the user scrolled a screen.
purposes.section_viewed: A content section came into view.
purposes.session_ended: Session quality: duration, active time, screens, core actions.
purposes.session_quality: Classified session: deep / engaged / shallow / bounce.
purposes.session_started: A real session began (30-min idle guard against DAU inflation).
purposes.share_completed: A share completed or was cancelled — viral loop.
purposes.share_photo_added: User added a personal photo to the share card (library or camera).
purposes.source_connected: A wearable/data source is connected — data can now flow.
purposes.stale_data_detected: Data went stale — pipeline death signal.
purposes.streak_broken: Lost a streak — habit loss signal.
purposes.streak_milestone: Hit a streak milestone — habit forming.
purposes.streak_rest_credit_granted: A rest-day credit granted (Duolingo-style streak softening).
purposes.streak_rest_credit_spent: A rest-day credit used to save a streak.
purposes.streaming_stopped: Live vitals streaming stopped, with duration.
purposes.subscription_cancel_detected: Auto-renew turned off while the paid period is still active (cancelled, not yet lapsed).
purposes.sync_failed: A sync failed, with reason — broken pipeline.
purposes.time_range_changed: Time range/timeframe switched on a chart.
purposes.time_to_first_value: Seconds from install to first real value.
purposes.trial_day_check: Per-session trial engagement vs days remaining.
purposes.trial_expired: Free trial ended. Dual-emitted with subscription_expired during dashboard migration.
purposes.trial_started: Trial began — start of the trial-to-paid funnel.
purposes.user_health_snapshot: Periodic snapshot of data coverage and churn-health score.
purposes.value_delivered: Did this session deliver new value (new insights)?
purposes.verdict_delivered: The prediction verdict was delivered on the onboarding reveal.
purposes.wake_anchor_drift_snapshot: Median wake-time drift against the anchor, once per Sleep Coach open. Success is this median falling within-user between week 1 and week 8.
purposes.wake_anchor_set: The user picked or changed their fixed wake time in Sleep Coach. Splits anchor-setters from non-setters, which is the cohort the whole feature is measured on.
purposes.weekly_score_change: Score trend direction week over week — the outcome metric.
